faqs.question: What is FOM SD 25 used for?
faqs.answer: FOM SD 25 is a PEEK slot-die coating head used for precise, uniform, non-contact thin-film deposition at coating widths up to 25 mm, built specifically for harsh chemical or high-temperature coating conditions.

faqs.question: Why choose PEEK over stainless steel for a slot-die head?
faqs.answer: PEEK offers exceptional thermal stability, broad chemical resistance, and low-friction wear reduction, making it better suited than steel for aggressive solvents or elevated process temperatures.

faqs.question: What coating width does FOM SD 25 support?
faqs.answer: It supports coating widths from 1 to 25 mm, the narrowest standard format in the PEEK series.

faqs.question: What flatness tolerance does FOM SD 25 hold?
faqs.answer: It holds a flatness tolerance of ≤ 5 µm across its entire surface.

faqs.question: What viscosity range can FOM SD 25 handle?
faqs.answer: It handles viscosities from 1 cPs up to over 100,000 cPs at 25°C.

faqs.question: Can FOM SD 25 be used for double-sided coating?
faqs.answer: Yes, double-sided coating applications are supported on the FOM moduloR2R machine.

faqs.question: Is FOM SD 25 easy to disassemble and clean?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's engineered specifically for effortless disassembly, assembly, and cleaning.

faqs.question: Does FOM SD 25 work with a meniscus guide?
faqs.answer: Yes, the design works with or without a meniscus guide, adapting to different coating applications.

faqs.question: Are wider PEEK slot-die heads available?
faqs.answer: Yes, FOM Technologies offers the PEEK Series in wider formats, including SD 50, SD 100, and SD 200, alongside the full Steel Series.

faqs.question: What is the price of FOM SD 25 in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on the shim, meniscus guide, and accessory configuration selected. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your requirements are confirmed.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: FOM SD 25 product information: PEEK construction, chemical resistance, and precision coating.
body: Constructed from Polyetheretherketone (PEEK), the head delivers exceptional thermal stability, chemical resistance, and mechanical durability suited to harsh coating environments.
Flatness tolerance holds at ≤ 5 µm across the entire surface, matching the precision of FOM's steel series heads despite the different material.
Coating widths span 1 to 25 mm, the narrowest standard format in the PEEK series, suited to small-format devices and precise, controlled coating runs.
Viscosity handling reaches from 1 cPs up to over 100,000 cPs at 25°C, covering thin, aggressive solvents through heavy formulations on the same head.
Exceptional thermal resistance lets the head withstand high temperatures encountered during coating without significant degradation.
High chemical resistance across a wide range of chemistries makes the head suitable for use with varied, aggressive coating materials.
Low friction characteristics reduce wear and frictional losses during coating, extending operational life and minimizing maintenance requirements.
A standard single manifold and a 1/2-20 UNF thread for tube connections come built into the head.
Lip protection on the slot-die supports a self-standing feature, aiding manufacturing processes.
The design works with or without a meniscus guide, adapting to different coating applications.
Custom shim and meniscus guide designs are supported, with precise FOM alignment design keeping shim and guide positioning reliable.
Double-sided coating applications are supported on the FOM moduloR2R machine.
A lightweight, high-quality protective flight case ships with the head for shipping and storage.

sections.title: Assembly, Maintenance, and Portability
body: A slot-die head that's difficult to disassemble or clean adds friction to every changeover, and FOM SD 25 is engineered specifically to remove that friction.

Lip protection on the slot-die supports a self-standing feature, making the head easier to handle and set down safely during manufacturing without needing a dedicated stand at every step. The design is engineered for effortless disassembly, assembly, and cleaning, and works with or without a meniscus guide depending on what a given coating application requires. A protective flight case ships with the head, keeping it protected during shipping and storage between uses, and an integrated pressure gauge enhances functionality directly on the unit.

A dilute precursor solution today, a thick electrode slurry next month — and on most systems that means a second slot-die head, a second alignment procedure, and a second thing to maintain. Machined from PEEK, it brings three properties that matter in aggressive chemistry: thermal stability that withstands high coating temperatures without significant degradation, chemical resistance across a wide range of coating materials, and low friction that reduces wear and extends operational life. sections.title: Why PEEK
sections.description: PEEK is chosen for three properties working together. Thermal stability lets the head withstand the high temperatures encountered during coating without significant degradation, and chemical resistance across a wide range of coating materials makes it suitable for aggressive solvent systems that would attack other constructions.
